claims: The University of California, Irvine (UCI) is a top-10 public research university in California.
Popular majors at UCI include biological sciences, social sciences, and engineering.
UCI has strengths in social sciences, biological sciences, engineering, and computer science.
Admission to UCI is based on a holistic review of academic achievements, extracurricular activities, and personal statements.
UCI is located in Orange County, CA.
UCI's campus has an "academic village" design.
UCI's research focus areas include climate resilience, heart care, and public health.
The acronym "UCI" also refers to the Union Cycliste Internationale.
The Union Cycliste Internationale is the world governing body for sports cycling.
The Union Cycliste Internationale is recognized by the International Olympic Committee.
The Union Cycliste Internationale oversees international cycling events and rules
